description: Change an existing Odoo opportunity (crm.lead): fields such as expected_revenue, stage_id, probability, name, partner_id, date_deadline, description. status "won" marks it won (Odoo's own action_set_won, moves it to the won stage), "lost" marks it lost. Only the fields you pass are touched. WRITES into the customer's ERP — goes through the permission gate.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

lead_id.description: ID of the lead to change

name: update_odoo_lead
